headline: Marsh McLennan (MMC) Q3 Earnings Lift Focus Toward Margin Pressure
summary: Marsh & McLennan came into this Q3 2026 report with a reputation as a resilient, fee-heavy insurance broker and consultancy, and the stock reflected that steady story, up around 7% over the past month before today and edging another 1% higher to about US$188 in the first full session after results. The headline this quarter is not flashy revenue; it is earnings quality.
